summary: fix: exit safety nets see the broker price (regular hours only; a fresh bar must agree), the exit window runs only max-loss and the hard stop on a copy of the exit levels, the quote rung cannot abort the tick (audit 2026-10-05 C05-01, C05-02, C06-02, with review fixes)
risks: 1 organism file(s) changed — replay verification required

Frozen decision surface changed (owner sign-off 2026-10-05): phase2_freeze --verify --candidate reports exactly source_hashes.entry_gates_dispatch and research_policy_sources.broker_state_safety; production needs a regenerated candidate_param_freeze.json and a new approved activation (new FROZEN_AT resets the forward clock).

tests/test_phase2_freeze.py::test_decision_surface_unchanged and ::test_verify_mode_passes_on_unchanged_surface fail by design until the release assembly regenerates candidate_param_freeze.json (deliberately not regenerated on this branch).

Live exit-path behaviour changes: the broker-price safety nets can now fire, but only in regular trading hours and, when the symbol has a fresh bar, only if the bar close also breaches; the exit window sends stop/max-loss exits for unclaimed shares on the next tick instead of about 10 ticks later. Its stop check runs on a copy of the exit levels, so window ticks leave the trailing anchor and MFE/MAE tracking unchanged, as in the base code.
A broker-price breach seen only on the 09:28-09:30 or 16:00-16:01 ET ticks (13:00-16:01 on early-close days) is logged and waits for the next regular-hours tick.

The bar confirmation uses the per-symbol staleness admission (_stale_entry_symbols, 120 s) for freshness; without a streaming provider (REST-only mode, tests, replay) every frame counts as fresh, so a lagging REST bar can delay a broker-price net until it agrees.
follow_ups: Release assembly: regenerate artifacts/phase2/candidate_param_freeze.json once for all frozen-code fixes, then activate (new FROZEN_AT, activation record, daily-evidence binding); research_policy_baseline.json stays unchanged.
Owner decision: should exit-window ticks advance the trailing anchor and MFE/MAE tracking (frozen during the window, as in the base code; see mapss Known limits)?
Routine and no-features exits still count a 'blocked' _submit_exit_order return as an order and arm the exit window (not in the changed code; practically unreachable there).
EOD flatten and the overnight forced exit still size from the full broker qty, not qty_available/unclaimed shares (an oversized flatten is refused by the PR #36 outbox guard).

After a restart an exit still queued in the outbox is invisible to qty_available; a window breach can send a second exit that only the outbox guard stops (mapss Known limits; the base code had the same exposure at tick N+10).
Pyramid close_partial reads pos_data['direction'], which PositionsService never supplies (latent; pyramiding is off in production).

An orphan close that never finds a price stays pending with per-tick saves (C06-03); the C06-02 quote rung has no quote-age check, so quote_* rows can be stale; bars_held still skips minute boundaries crossed during the exit window.

artifacts/frozen_repairs_20260927/causal_features/replay_{crash,eod}.json are stale against 27c29897 (the crash scenario now labels two bar-41 exits max_loss_limit instead of pyramid_cut_full_*, same bar, shares and P&L), and tests/test_cross_asset_alignment_replay.py rewrites them whenever it runs.

PR text: _live_tick_inner 2850 -> 2879 lines in the first cut (ceilings +27 after 2 lines of prior headroom) and -> 2889 in the review fix (ceilings +10, exact); the portfolio API's current_price now shows Alpaca's price instead of 0 (display only).
